## What
One or two sentences on what this changes.

## Why
The problem it solves, or the ticket.

## How it was tested
- [ ] Unit and integration tests
- [ ] Preview checked by hand (link)
- [ ] Mobile width (375) and desktop (1440) if UI

## Risk and rollback
What could break, and exactly how to undo it. Note any migration and whether it can be reversed.

## Security
- [ ] Auth checked on any new route or API
- [ ] Inputs validated
- [ ] No secrets in code, logs or client bundles
- [ ] No new public surface (or owner approved it)

## Records
- [ ] Docs updated (README, runbook, ADR)
- [ ] STUDIO-LOG entry if this changes infrastructure, access or data
